parts.t: Welcome to Autumn Ridge in the heart of Murrayville — a top-floor, 2 bed/2 bath corner unit with just one shared wall. Extensively updated: fresh paint, new gas fireplace, wide-plank vinyl flooring throughout, upgraded appliances, baseboards & lighting. The living room offers a large window and glass slider to the partially covered east-facing deck — perfect for morning coffee and sun. Kitchen with white cabinetry, stainless appliances, tile backsplash & deck access. Large primary with walk-in closet & 4-pc ensuite, good-sized second bedroom, 3-pc main bath. Great complex with clubhouse & exercise room. Secure underground parking, EV charging area & storage locker. Pets w/ restrictions. Walk to restaurants, shops, W.C. Blair Rec Centre, hospital, parks & schools!

v: Top Floor Unit, Common Walls - No One Above, One Level

Top-floor corner unit with just one shared wall — 1,002 sq ft of single-level living. Wide-plank vinyl flooring throughout, fresh paint, new gas fireplace, and upgraded baseboards and lighting (2025). Large window and glass slider to the deck.
White cabinetry with stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash, and direct deck access. Full appliance package included: washer, dryer, fridge, stove, dishwasher, and microwave.
Primary bedroom (11'0 x 13'11) with walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite. Second bedroom 12'5 x 10'2, plus a 3-piece main bath. In-suite laundry.
Partially covered east-facing balcony off both the living room and kitchen — morning sun and coffee, sheltered enough to use in shoulder season.
Secure underground parking (stall 61) plus storage locker E61. EV chargers in the underground parking area and visitor parking on site.
Elevator, exercise centre, and clubhouse/recreation room. Three-storey wood-frame building with brick, vinyl, and wood exterior on a concrete perimeter foundation.

Maintenance fee $443.33/month, covering gas, hot water, garbage pickup, gardening, management, and recreation facility. Managed by CrossRoads Management Ltd. Pets welcome with restrictions: two dogs (max 14" at the withers, 40 lbs), two cats, or a combination. Rentals allowed with restrictions.
Murrayville's Autumn Ridge — one block to public transit, four blocks to school bus. Walk to restaurants, shops, W.C. Blair Rec Centre, Langley Memorial Hospital, parks, and schools.
